title: Genesis 17:19 — Named before Birth: Sarah will bear a son, Isaac
summary: God tells Abraham that Sarah will bear him a son to be named Isaac, with whom He will establish His everlasting covenant; large caption 'Named before Birth'. The English heading reads Genesis 18:19 while the Hebrew heading reads 17:19, the verse actually quoted.
